The '''TLB power converter''' was manufactured by [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]], and was part of the power system of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] when the vessel was owned by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].

[[Gaor Tembon]] had installed six converters in his modified freighter ''[[Miv'rah Firestorm]]'' to handle the increased power from the power core. However, to hide the increased power from custom inspectors, he would shunt 30% of the energy to the converters and cause them to blow out.<ref name="WBC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>
